name: Argument-Based Comparative Question Answering Evaluation Benchmark
description: This benchmark provides an evaluation framework for assessing the quality of comparative question answering summaries using 15 criteria derived from manual and LLM-based annotations. It includes two comparative question answering datasets and evaluates multiple LLMs under different settings.
reputation: A recent evaluation benchmark for comparative question answering and summary quality that is still emerging rather than widely standardized.
notes: Includes 15 evaluation criteria for comparative QA summaries; uses both manual and LLM annotations.
